title: Multiple high-clearance sources say UAP is a real phenomenon
summary: Tyler Cowen tells of Multiple high-clearance sources say UAP is a real phenomenon, about 2021-2022 at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: One thing I've learned over the last year, I've heard from a whole bunch of people, totally separate sources with like very, very high security clearances, and I mean very high.

plain: The economist Tyler Cowen says that over the past year he heard from many separate people with very high security clearances, meaning access to the government's most secret information, who told him that unidentified aerial phenomena, the official term for UFOs, are real. He tells Jesse Michels this as something he was told, without naming the people. It matters to him because the sources were independent of each other and well placed to know.
